title: Isolated browser-run fixtures
responsibility: Resolves, creates and cleans per-run fixture locations and assigns browser-test ports.

inputs.name: e2eFixtures.env
inputs.description: Optional environment map, defaulting to process.env; requires HARNESS_E2E_ROOT.

inputs.name: freePorts.count
inputs.description: Number of loopback ports to sample; zero returns an empty list.

inputs.name: openE2eRun.env
inputs.description: Optional mutable environment map, defaulting to process.env. Existing directory and named ports are retained; unnamed ports are assigned.

inputs.name: namedE2eRun.env
inputs.description: Optional environment map, defaulting to process.env, inspected for a named root without an owner.

inputs.name: closeE2eRun.env
inputs.description: Optional environment map, defaulting to process.env; cleanup requires this process to own its root.

outputs.name: e2eFixtures
outputs.description: Run root, report/console/analytics/build locations and a site-path function. Console and analytics environment overrides are honored.

outputs.name: freePorts
outputs.description: Ports that were available when a child process briefly listened, then released them. They are not reserved for later use.

outputs.name: openE2eRun
outputs.description: Creates a temporary run directory and records this process as owner when none was named, assigns missing port variables, and returns fixture locations.

outputs.name: namedE2eRun
outputs.description: True when a root is set without an owner marker.

outputs.name: closeE2eRun
outputs.description: Removes the owned run directory and its frozen build cache. Does nothing when another process owns the run or no root exists.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Missing HARNESS_E2E_ROOT throws explicit guidance. Filesystem, child-process and parsing failures may propagate.
